verdict.rationale: Unity's own Build Automation service provides continuous-integration builds that run without a user present. Headless/batchmode modes and the Unity CLI support CI build agents. This is background automation limited to builds, and the AI Assistant's prompt-driven 'automate workflows' is interactive, not autonomous. missing for 10: documented triggers or recurring schedules for automations, general-purpose (non-build) background automation, autonomous agent-driven background tasks, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Use Unity Build Automation and its continuous integration features for multiplatform builds.
Build Automation supports most popular version control systems and builds for multiple platforms simultaneously, including iOS.
Run the application in headless mode. In this mode, the application doesn’t display anything or accept user input.
The Unity CLI works well for: Continuous integration (CI) and build agents where installing the full Hub is undesirable.
